Name: Relay Failure
Short description: The link to Earth goes down. Nothing arrives or leaves for six months.
Extended description: No verification, no settlement, no instruction. Whatever was in flight stays in flight.
Facilitator notes: Push on anything that needs a third party to confirm something. Insurance, escrow, letters of credit.

Name: The Ship Doesn't Come
Short description: Resupply misses its window. What was ordinary is now rationed.
Extended description: Prices move overnight, and the things people were holding as value turn out not to be the things that matter.
Facilitator notes: Ask what the team's instrument is denominated in, and whether that still buys anything.

Name: Earth Changes the Rules
Short description: A new law makes your instrument illegal to hold. You hear four months late.
Extended description: The rule applied from the day it passed. Everything done since was done in breach of it.
Facilitator notes: The interesting part is the gap, not the law. Ask what happens to transactions made in good faith inside it.

Name: The Fast Route Opens
Short description: A journey that took two years now takes four months.
Extended description: Every position priced on distance and delay is repriced at once, in someone else's favour.
Facilitator notes: Strongest against long-duration contracts. Ask who was holding the risk that just evaporated, and who paid for it.

Name: The Currency Slips
Short description: The Earth currency your contracts are written in halves in a week.
Extended description: Obligations stay the same size on paper. What they are worth does not.
Facilitator notes: Ask whether the team can settle in something else, and who gets to choose.

Name: The Big Counterparty Lied
Short description: The largest player in the system has been misstating what it holds.
Extended description: Reputation was the collateral. Nobody was checking, because checking was expensive and slow.
Facilitator notes: Lethal to anything with one central node. Ask what the system does the second time it happens.

Name: A Generation Arrives
Short description: Population doubles in a year, mostly people born there who signed nothing.
Extended description: The system was designed by and for the people who arrived. They are now a minority.
Facilitator notes: Ask who the instrument is actually for, and what claim someone has who never agreed to it.

Name: Clocks Diverge
Short description: The parties no longer agree what time it is, and the disagreement matters.
Extended description: Nobody agreed whose clock governs, and the drift has grown past what the contracts can absorb.
Facilitator notes: Push on anything with a date in it. Maturity, interest, claim windows. Teams usually find they never specified.
